notes.title: Achievements and updates!
notes.notes:
Thank you all so much for being so supportive! Several times a week I received emails asking me to add achievements to the game! And I did it!

Not only achievements were added, but also a little bit of gameplay updates. There are a couple of new dialogs, one mini-game, and also, something else!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45056222/623b167c9167ad6ea46998dfeb2d61109fdf737a.png[/img]

notes.title: THANKS! WE SOLD 700 COPIES
notes.notes:
[b]I'm happy[/b] to report that we've [b]sold over 700 copies of Deep Inside![/b]
That's a great number for my first project! I'm very happy that it resonates with such a large audience!

I have definitely taken all the mistakes I made into account and will try not to make them in the next projects! [b]See you soon![/b]

notes.title: Congratulations! We made 300 sales!
notes.notes:
[b]Deep Inside[/b] sales have passed the[b] 300 copies sold[/b] mark! I am very glad that you like my game and leave positive feedback!

I'll keep you happy with more new projects!
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45056222/2d6f83dfea31d88a78f7f7cf661f03f4e2098a8e.png[/img]

notes.title: Deep Inside - is out on RELEASE!
notes.notes:
The work on [b]Deep Inside[/b] is finally finished. And I can say that the game has gone into [b]Release![/b] It's been a labor-intensive two months.

I hope that all of you will enjoy my work!
